nodes.author: drshim_derm
nodes.text: @LasVegasLocally Most likely it is metapneumovirus. But influenza A and B are going around. Metapneumovirus cough is worse than Covid, comes in spasms and lingers for weeks. Doesn't respond to steroids or other cough medicines. Requires special medications like those for post nasal drip.

nodes.author: Celestemary73
nodes.text: @drshim_derm @LasVegasLocally I had Metapneumovirus last year. It was awful and it kicked my butt. It came on really fast in March. Very contagious. I coughed for a month. Had to go back on two different inhalers to finally kick it. I get all of the recommended respiratory vaccines annually.

nodes.author: SerlyFilya
nodes.text: @drshim_derm @LasVegasLocally I had human metapneumovirus last spring and suddenly decompensated to a O2 sat of 82% on six Lof oxygen.  My lactate was over 2000 and my blood sugar was in the 400s. My cough would come in waves and I swear to God it broke ribs. It hurt to move it hurt to breathe and I had to be

nodes.author: drshim_derm
nodes.text: @SerlyFilya @LasVegasLocally Yes I developed chest pain and I had coughed so hard I got costochondritis. I was worried I had angina!

nodes.author: SerlyFilya
nodes.text: I was ill with a high fever and a sore throat for 3 days. Then suddenly, for a day, I felt better, then that night it started getting painful to breathe, and I started having coughing spasms. I went to the Urgent Care, and in the 30 minutes I was there, is when I decompensated and they called 911. I even had stress incontinence when the doctor made me walk from the exam room table to the door to see what my O2 SATs would do. Obviously, they bottomed out in the '80s, I had urine incontinence right there in front of the doctor and went into a coughing fit so hard, I was actually crying and gasping for air. I thought it was over for me.  Then the increase lactate level made them put me on a septic watch, and they had to push fluids into me so fast. It took a few days to get my lactate out of the critical level. My kidneys had acute kidney injury due to the low O2 sats. It was a horrible time. I had never even heard of the human metapneumovirus before then.  They tested me, I think, for four or five days before they finally figured out what I had.
